theses.thesis: T1: AI demand keeps semiconductor revenue growing fast enough to support consensus FY2026 revenue of about $106 billion.
theses.signpost: Semiconductor revenue growth of at least 40% year on year in the fiscal 2026 10-K, due by early December 2026. Interim invalidation: growth below 20% in any fiscal 2026 quarter, or a cut in FY2026 consensus revenue beyond the level set in the annual report.

theses.thesis: T2: Infrastructure software keeps its high margin as the subscription transition continues.
theses.signpost: Software operating income growth of at least 25% in the fiscal 2026 10-K, due by early December 2026. Invalidation: software operating income growth below the 10% level set in the annual report.

theses.thesis: T3: Gross margin holds near 68% even as AI rack sales grow, so the margin expansion lasts.
theses.signpost: Reported gross margin of at least 66% in each fiscal 2026 quarter. Invalidation: quarterly gross margin below 63%, the fiscal 2024 level.

theses.thesis: T4: Earnings estimates keep rising, so the current valuation stays supported by consensus rather than requiring a higher growth rate.
theses.signpost: FY2027 EPS consensus holds at or above $19 through the fiscal 2026 10-K, due by early December 2026. Invalidation: FY2027 EPS consensus cut by more than the level set in the annual report, or the stock trades above 40x forward earnings without an earnings upgrade.
